column1: # Fig 5A's named labels (frozen §33; specs/signature_sources_proposal.md: for signatures over about 50 genes, the
# source's named top genes; shorter lists in full). Read by the figure script only (frozen §48: kept outside
# config/signatures/, whose files are in the code hash of every stage importing sc2bulk.signatures). Every gene
# and direction is as in config/signatures/<pair>.tsv (current symbols).
# hammond: Holtman 2015 blue-module hub genes named in the proposal (symbols as in config/signatures/hammond.tsv)
# tms: Palmer 2021 top genes by rank named in the proposal's domain review (human symbols)
# soundlife: Peters 2015 ranks 1-50 (Table 1's top 50; the pinned list is in RANK order, checked against the raw file)
# lupus: all 21 Yao 2009 genes (under 50, so every gene is labelled)
# crohns: Haberman 2014 module representatives named in the proposal's domain review (CXCL9 up, as corrected there)
# pineda: Lederer 2007 genes named in the proposal (57 genes, over about 50, so only the named ones)
